★ Request
Nishino Flower runs off

No, it's fine. It looked like they were looking forward to it much more than me.
Flower-chan, is there anything you'd like to eat?

Watching you run, Flower-chan, gave us so much confidence.
After all, our little treasure was shining so brightly out there.

...I tripped and took a fall.
Looking at my scraped knee only sinks my mood further.

Yes, absolutely. You gave Mom and Dad courage.
That there's no need to shrink back—we should hold our heads high.

I'm sorry! I've already made up my mind... um,
I really feel like a veteran Trainer would be better, you know...

Everyone is giving it their all in the Little Kids' Trial Race!
...Oh?! Nishino Flower is surging right to the front!
A-Are you alright?!

Hehe, you're very welcome. If it still hurts,
please head to the infirmary, okay? See you!

But, Daddy... If the register count doesn't match up later,
the clerk will really be in trouble.

But Mommy, you said you wanted that macaron earlier...
Should I tell them we'll buy it?

Though it's common for rookie Trainers,
being so painfully aware of my own lack of experience and polish makes it sting all the more.
...From my... running...?

The Umamusume who placed a cute floral bandage on my knee.
She looks quite young, but she must be a student here at Tracen Academy... I assume.

Oh, there's still limited editions left! I've been looking forward
to this ever since I saw it in that magazine... Ah, I-I'm sorry. Were you planning on buying this...?
(My dad is a very gentle person.)
(He's so gentle that he'll apologize even when he hasn't done anything wrong.)

...Ngh, Flower! Do your best!!
You can win, Flower, I know you can!

Right there! Make your move right there... Yes! That's our Flower-chan!!
Go for it, go for it!! Don't lose!
(No, that's not it. Being beside the two of them makes my heart feel so warm. That's why I want them to always be smiling, just like the brilliant, shining sun.)
Yes, absolutely! The applause all around us was incredible...! We were even bragging to everyone that she was our girl!

Let's find a place to train! Somewhere she can run with all her might!
We might as well buy some spacious land and get all the equipment ready...!

There are still limited edition macarons left! Thank goodness~.
Flower-chan, let's eat them together. Excuse me, could I get this—
I see, they have to balance the register at the end of the day. Yeah, you're right, Flower. Daddy will go take care of it. ...I'm terribly sorry for the trouble. Um—

Amazing... She's overtaking them one after another...
To run like that without shrinking back from anyone around her...

That looks really painful though... Ah, please lean on my shoulder!
Don't worry, I'm an Umamusume too!

! Of course! Mommy and Daddy will help you with everything we've got!
First, we need shoes! We have to buy really good ones! And then...
(If seeing me run can make them shine with joy, then I want to run more and more. So much that everyone watching turns into bright sunshine.)
(She's an Umamusume who always puts herself second and prioritizes everyone else around her.)

Ah, no, um... P-Please, go ahead. We're still thinking about it...
...I'm sorry, Flower-chan. Let's pick something else after all.
"I'm sorry for being so unreliable."

I had shown such a pathetic side of myself, but her kindness
was enough to soothe my disheartened spirit.

You were amazing! Taking on all those runners with your small frame, it was so admirable!
Ah, I'm so happy... Daddy is so proud of you...!

...Ngh. Daddy, Mommy!
I... want to run more! I want to enter lots of races!

Flower... is looking straight ahead...
With such sheer confidence...

So fast, so fast! She broke away from the lead pack in the blink of an eye!
Nishino Flower crosses the finish line in first place!

She tends to my injury with brisk efficiency while constantly checking on me.
Her skillful touch is so mesmerizing that I almost lose myself in watching her.
Walking aimlessly through the campus in my disheartened state—

Um, you're a rookie Trainer, right?
I'm sorry... Maybe if another opportunity comes along...

(Those two kind and warm people are smiling so brightly.
Just like the vivid sun shining over a field of blooming flowers—)
—That is my dream.

How long has it been since I arrived at the Academy as a Trainer?
After the selection races ended, I reached out to an Umamusume who caught my eye—

(I wondered what I could possibly do for them.
Then, one day, while thinking about that—)
(My mom is a very warm Umamusume.)

Ah, the change is short... Well, it's not worth making a fuss over.
Anyone can make a mistake.

(I want my races to bring courage... to turn everyone into radiant sunshine.
And if that makes Mommy and Daddy smile even more...!)
(Those two kind and warm people sometimes look at me with sad, apologetic faces.)
Oh dear... Can you sit down on that bench over there?

Don't let it get you down, don't let it get you down!
As long as you don't give up, there's always hope! You can do it!

Phew. Disinfectant applied, and the bandage is set.
...Um, how does it feel? Are you able to walk?

Phew... Daddy, Mommy, I'm back!
Your voices really surprised me! I've never heard you cheer so loudly—
